title: Доступ, використання та атрибуція
roles: R02 та уповноважений фахівець із прав
fields_and_relations: Рівень, мета, поля/медіа, строк/ембарго, форма імені, точні підстави.
required_interaction: Public/research preview; конфлікт/прострочення/unknown consent не дають allow.

implementation.view_model: Search/filter decisions; wizard with exact source and consent bases, evidence, dates, uses, field masks, resources, attribution; reviewed projection and policy history.
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v9; existing user state is preserved, new grants require explicit human review.
permissions: Separate scoped review.write, publication.write and access.manage grants
Applying description changes also requires catalog.write
Navigation and demo account choice do not change permission assignments
implementation.atomicity: Review, exact result revision, evidence, verification and application commit together. Deferred review retains a task. Source changes invalidate linked effective policies and withdraw affected publications. Revocation withdraws linked publications in the same transaction.
limitations: Local browser enforcement; no server authentication or automatic legal assessment.
Rights management does not implement a new media player or network transport.
